aiAssistant.title: Control by an AI assistant
aiAssistant.allow: Allow an AI assistant to control the app (MCP)
aiAssistant.allowDescription: Control is on after a fresh install. You can switch it off here; that choice survives updates. An AI assistant such as Claude Desktop or Claude Code can then operate the app through the bundled MCP server: build models, calculate, run checks and create reports. Only programs on this computer can reach the channel, with a key that is new at every start. The choice applies immediately and is remembered; Save or Cancel does not change it.
aiAssistant.statusEnv: Switched on for this session when the app started (by an AI assistant through gui_start_app, or with OPENAEC_GUI_CONTROL=1); the saved setting is off, so the channel will be off at the next start.
aiAssistant.statusBrowser: Only available in the desktop app.
aiAssistant.serverMissing: The MCP server ({{naam}}) was not found.
aiAssistant.serverHint: The installer puts the server next to the app. In a development build: cargo build --release -p openaec-mcp-server.
aiAssistant.claudeDesktopDescription: Adds the entry "{{naam}}" to {{config}}. Other servers and settings stay as they are; a backup copy is made next to the file first.

result.aangemaakt: Created {{config}} with the entry for Open FEM Studio.
result.ongewijzigd: Already set up in {{config}}; nothing changed.

aiAssistant.duplicate: Note: {{namen}} starts the same server; Claude Desktop will then show the tools twice. Remove that entry yourself if it is no longer needed.
